notes.title: "The Goddess of Time and the Ice Princess ep 1" Store Page Up!
notes.notes:
The Goddess of Time and the Ice princess ep 1 now has a Steam store page up!  [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1398830/The_Goddess_of_Time_and_the_Ice_Princess_episode_1/]Wishlist it here![/url]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38179389/151222085659a492f3ec0f9c1bedd66067a9a870.png[/img]

"The Goddess of Time and the Ice princess ep 1" is the first part of a yuri visual novel following the love story of Catherine and Sabrina, along with the secrets that hold the Ice Princess. 

I'm very happy with the coming release of another Visual Novel!

If you want, you can wishlist the game on Steam for an email when it’s released.

notes.title: Update Notice V 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Hi,

For reasons beyond our control previous content is not possible to be added to the novel.

We're very sorry for any inconvenience this may cause you. 

- Compensation -
Two additional chapters following the main story will be added as compensation for all the trouble. One on the next patch this month, and the final one through September.

Thank you.
